function stopCarouselAutoplay(c, permanently?): void

Defined in: website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/autoplay.ts:82

Stops autoplay and drains the progress ring. permanently latches _autoplayPermanentlyStopped — every user-initiated navigation (arrow/dot/swipe/hover) passes true so the carousel never auto-plays again on this page; visibility/modal stops pass false and may resume.

Parameters

c

CarouselAutoplayHost

The carousel host.

permanently?

boolean = false

Latch user intent — no future resumes.

Returns

void
